nina: Quick sync  I opened a docs PR to add explicit examples for quota-tier attribution & metering math. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1489
rahul: saw it. main ask: make the example concrete with numbers for a 3-tier setup (free, pro, enterprise)
kevin: agree. also we need to avoid implying per-request latency guarantees in the pricing doc
nina: noted. rahul can you draft the 3-tier numeric example? keep it short
rahul: draft below, please sanity-check:
"""
Example: tiered metering
- Free: 0-100k tokens/month at $0.00, rate limit 60 req/min
- Pro: 100k-5M tokens/month at $0.0006/token, rate limit 600 req/min
- Enterprise: >5M tokens/month negotiated, reserved quota option available
Billing math example: Pro customer uses 1.2M tokens in billing cycle -> first 100k free, 1.1M billable tokens * $0.0006 = $660
"""
kevin: looks good, but add note about prorating and burst credits
